notes.title: Crash fix in settings menu
notes.content: • Fixed crash when trying to enter the settings menu

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
• Fixed crash when trying to enter the settings menu
• Mobs now do not spawn next to the player
• Improved Blades of Chaos weapon
• Corrected prices and damage of some weapons
• Magic weapon damage increased by 30%
• Reduced consumption of magical weapons
• Celestial Scourge lightning now uses Soul of Light to regenerate health
• Regeneration of health when using Soul of Light is now faster
